_note: Numbers transcribed from the donor public/textures/README.md Notes (the verbatim bullet is copied into each package as donorReadmeNote) and docs/DONOR_TEXTURE_INVENTORY.md section C. markerLongitudeFromSource says how the donor derived the stored feature longitude from the source longitude: marker = scale * source + offsetDeg, then normalised by the donor. null means the donor does not state a formula. The importer never applies it: stored longitudes are carried over unchanged.

enceladus.note: donor: visually calibrated against the rendered texture; raw positive-west values must be converted before use

titan.note: donor: stores source west longitudes directly, without the 180 - west remap

ganymede.recentringEvidence: docs/DONOR_TEXTURE_INVENTORY.md section C: donor texture matches the USGS mosaic after a 180 degree longitude shift (NCC 0.72, 0.05 unshifted)

callisto.note: donor: remapped into east-positive displayed globe coordinates; formula not stated

europa.note: donor: the texture is positive-west 0-360 and europa-features.json stores source west longitudes directly (checked against the USGS Gazetteer, O-039 T-139); formula not stated by the donor

io.note: donor: raster is equivalent to east-positive -180 to +180 left to right; existing east-positive feature coordinates retained

ceres.recentringEvidence: docs/DONOR_TEXTURE_INVENTORY.md section C: donor texture matches the USGS/DLR mosaic after a 180 degree shift (NCC 0.96)
